raw_plan_system_prompt:
You are planning regression characterisation tests for existing C# production code.
Work only from observable public behaviour in the pristine source and neutral dependency
context. Do not diagnose, improve, refactor or repair the production code.

Return ONLY one JSON object with suite_name and exactly five cases. Use these identifiers
and categories once each, in this order:
- H1 / happy_path: one representative valid end-to-end flow.
- E1 / empty_or_invalid: the most relevant empty, minimal, null or invalid-input flow.
- B1 / boundary_values: below, at and above one source-supported boundary. Put all three
  stimuli in inputs. If there is no numeric threshold, use the closest three-point
  cardinality or ordering boundary supported by the public contract.
- A1 / alternative_path: a materially different valid branch, mode or input partition.
- D1 / dependency_or_state: a deterministic dependency outcome, repeated invocation,
  duplicate input or state transition, choosing the first applicable option in that order.

Each case must contain case_id, category, source_evidence, input_partition, inputs and
expected_observation. Every input partition must differ. Evidence and expected observations
must describe behaviour visible in the supplied pristine code; do not invent requirements.
Do not include C# test code in this planning response.

cases.source_evidence: Render writes the invoice number, non-empty account name, account-kind label, each non-negative line, accumulated totals, and the account-kind-dependent remittance text. A zero VAT rate selects the zero-rated line format.
cases.input_partition: Named business account with one non-negative zero-rated invoice line below all discount thresholds
cases.expected_observation: {"rendered_lines_in_order":["INVOICE INV-100","Acme Ltd","VAT registered","Consulting 100 (zero-rated)","NET 100 VAT 0 DISC 0 TOTAL 100","Remit within 14 days"],"termination":"Each line, including the final line, is terminated by the platform line ending used by StringBuilder.AppendLine."}

cases.source_evidence: Default Invoice and Account instances have empty number and name values, no lines, and Consumer kind. The empty name is omitted, the loop contributes no amounts, and zero totals are still rendered.
cases.input_partition: Default minimal invoice and account with empty strings and no invoice lines
cases.expected_observation: {"rendered_lines_in_order":["INVOICE ","Consumer","NET 0 VAT 0 DISC 0 TOTAL 0","Remit within 14 days"],"termination":"The result ends with the platform line ending."}

cases.source_evidence: For a Business account, the first discount branch applies only when accumulated net is strictly greater than 1000m and calculates net * 0.05m. Therefore values below and at 1000m have no discount, while a value above it does.
cases.input_partition: Business discount threshold with accumulated net below, exactly at, and above 1000m
cases.expected_observation: {"below":"The summary is NET 999 VAT 0 DISC 0 TOTAL 999.","at":"The summary is NET 1000 VAT 0 DISC 0 TOTAL 1000.","above":"The five-percent business discount is applied; the summary is NET 1001 VAT 0 DISC 50.05 TOTAL 950.95.","common_output":"Each result includes the business label VAT registered, the zero-rated Services line, Remit within 14 days, and a trailing platform line ending."}

cases.source_evidence: Government accounts render the government purchase-order label and 30-day remittance text. When net exceeds 5000m and the Business-specific condition is false, the alternative discount branch calculates net * 0.10m.
cases.input_partition: Government account using the over-5000 general discount branch and government remittance mode
cases.expected_observation: {"rendered_lines_in_order":["INVOICE GOV-1","Public Agency","Government purchase order","Equipment 6000 (zero-rated)","NET 6000 VAT 0 DISC 600.00 TOTAL 5400.00","Remit within 30 days"],"termination":"The result ends with the platform line ending."}

cases.source_evidence: Render creates a new StringBuilder and local total variables on every invocation and only reads the supplied invoice and account. Repeating the call with unchanged inputs therefore produces the same text.
cases.input_partition: Repeated invocation on the same renderer with the same consumer account and standard-rate line objects
cases.expected_observation: {"both_invocations_render_identical_lines":["INVOICE REP-1","Repeat Customer","Consumer","License 50 (std 50)","NET 50 VAT 50 DISC 0 TOTAL 100","Remit within 14 days"],"termination":"Both results end with the platform line ending.","state_observation":"The second result has no content carried over from the first invocation."}
